text: Meet Greenwood Park Trio, where sunlight steals the show and the little details deserve an encore! This detached, new-construction home shines with a sprawling, custom floor plan offering high ceilings and a wall of windows that lets the day pour in. A chef's kitchen with a generous island seating four, makes room for morning coffee & culinary adventures. Open, airy living spaces invite you to settle in, spread out, and stay awhile, with a convenient powder room on the main. All three bedrooms are positioned upstairs. Top floor primary has dual closets and in the primary bath, cozy radiant floor heat greets your toes, and an artfully crafted, envelope-cut shower floor adds a distinctive finishing touch. There's no carpeting anywhere-just a fresh, cohesive feel throughout. Head to the rooftop deck for lovely territorial views and a little daydreaming, or enjoy the south-facing patio with oversized stamped-concrete pavers. Easy parking with an EV charger and an included full-size washer and dryer keep the practical side of life beautifully in step. Last but not least no HOA dues!!

Primary bedroom suite includes spa-like bath and view deck. Three wood burning fireplaces. Two huge dressing rooms, 3rd floor sound studio/bedroom. Delightful cottage is perfect Guest/MIL/Nanny quarters or art studio. Easy location between Lake Washington Beaches and the commercial districts of Madrona, Madison Valley, Madison Park and Leschi, and only 2 miles to Downtown Seattle. Swift access to both bridges, University of Washington and all hospitals. A truly enchanting home!
